title: Handoff note
description: The YAML in the `aidd-handoff` block a role ends each run with (references/handoff.md). It is a report from an agent, so it is data: never a person's yes, and never evidence. `aidd validate` warns about a note that breaks this shape, and about hidden characters or text posing as a person's words in it. It advises and blocks nothing. The latest note in a document counts. `next` is checked against the roles in roles.json, `status` against the Spec statuses, and the first word of `stopped_at` against the stop codes, because those lists have their own owners.

done.description: What the run did, with the evidence it names. Debt found and left goes here as `debt: <what, where>`.

next.description: The role that takes the work next, such as `verifier`. A role, never an approval and never a person's decision.

needs.description: A decision only a person can give, in one sentence, or `none`. A choice between options points to a decision card.

stopped_at.description: Why the run stopped: one stop code (`stop_code` in the common schema), alone or followed by `: ` and any detail, such as `stopped_at: "ask: spec.approve SPEC-3"`, quoted because of the colon. `none` when nothing stopped it. In a headless run, `ask`, with the ask it reached.

by.description: Who wrote the note: an agent writes `agent:<harness id>/<model>`, the value of its commits' `Assisted-by`, such as `agent:claude-code/claude-opus-5-5`. `aidd eval work` counts the note's step under it, and without it under the commit that posted the note. It is a label the writer gave, never proof, and it decides nothing.

spend.description: The harness's count of the run's tokens or cost, copied, or `unknown`; never an estimate. A run seldom sees its own count, so it writes `unknown`, and the lead's journal holds the harness's count.

status.description: The Spec status the run stopped in (`aidd status` shows it): one of the Spec statuses.

head.description: The commit the run checked, such as the verifier's or the reviewer's head. A delegated merge needs the latest note to name its exact head with `needs: none`.

asked.description: What a person asked the role directly, and what the role did with it.

decided.description: What the role settled itself, each with what settled it.
